mappings.scope: Database entities, enums and migration-visible data model semantics.
mappings.reason: Prisma is the canonical owner of the persisted data model; generated entities and human data/migration semantics must be reviewed together.

mappings.scope: Role set, permission policy and authorization guard semantics.
mappings.reason: RBAC inventory is generated, while object/role access semantics remain a human contract.

mappings.scope: Authentication, session, cookie, token lifecycle and password-reset behaviour.
mappings.reason: These behaviours are public/security-sensitive semantics that cannot be reconstructed from the compact generated API index.

mappings.scope: HTTP method/path/auth metadata and manually documented API semantics.
mappings.reason: Runtime OpenAPI/controllers own the surface; compact generated inventory and human contracts must not drift.

mappings.scope: Supported environment variables and deploy/local configuration contract.
mappings.reason: Configuration changes can break startup or deployment even when application API code is unchanged.

mappings.scope: Production image startup, Railway deployment and production migration gate procedures.
mappings.reason: Deployment/migration procedures are operational contracts and must stay synchronized with executable configuration.

mappings.scope: Required quality/security/release gates and their executable CI policy.
mappings.reason: Changes to required checks, waivers or release enforcement must be reviewed against current quality/release documentation.

mappings.scope: Production Nest module composition and documented module boundaries.
mappings.reason: AppModule owns runtime module composition; generated inventory and human boundary rationale must remain aligned.
